description: This file implements a command-line utility for encrypting and decrypting firmware files for Buffalo devices using XOR-based header cryptography. It handles file input/output, key-based data transformation, and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command-line options.

methods.name: crypt_header
methods.description: Performs XOR-based encryption/decryption on a buffer using specified keys.

methods.name: crypt_file
methods.description: Reads a file into memory, applies encryption or decryption, and writes the result to an output file.

methods.name: check_params
methods.description: Validates that input and output filenames are specified.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses command-line arguments and orchestrates the encryption/decryption process.
